ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction — the strongest signal of the session. NVDA delivered a clean beat-and-raise for Q2 FY2027 (revenue $96.22B vs $92.4B consensus, EPS $2.22 vs $2.09), with Q3 guidance of ~$108B (~3.8% above street) and CEO citing ~70% FY2028 revenue growth with supply locked in, setting up a gap-up open on Aug 27. At ~$218-219 AH vs ~$209 pre-earnings, the stock still trades at ~25x forward earnings vs a historical 35-40x range, implying meaningful re-rating room even after the after-hours move.
ideas.catalyst: Q2 FY2027 earnings reported Aug 26 after close; market reaction hits at open Aug 27; Q3 guide of ~$108B vs $103.9B consensus is the primary re-rating driver
ideas.edge: Revenue beat of ~4.4% ($96.22B vs $92.2B est) with Q3 guide ~3.8% above consensus; stock pre-earnings ~$209, AH ~$218-219 (~+4.7%); options implied move was ~5.4% pre-earnings — blowout Q3 guide likely drives a wider opening gap; stock still ~35-40% below historical forward P/E range
ideas.bull_case: A sustained gap-up open on the Q3 guide beat triggers momentum buying and short covering; CEO's 70% FY2028 growth comment with supply visibility supports a forward P/E re-rating toward historical norms, implying $260-280+ on a full re-rating.
ideas.bear_case: Post-earnings IV crush is severe — outright options lose value rapidly even if the stock moves as expected; if the opening gap is smaller than the implied move, call buyers lose; macro headwinds (rising yields, hawkish Warsh speech Friday) could cap index-level enthusiasm.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc.
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction — tied with NVDA as the top consensus name. SKHY is the primary HBM memory supplier to NVIDIA and thus the most direct supply-chain beneficiary of NVDA's blowout Q3 guide and ~70% FY2028 revenue growth outlook; NVDA's print serves as a same-session demand confirmation. The stock has pulled back ~11% from its $178 Aug 17 high to the mid-$150s despite a stacked set of independent catalysts: a 40 trillion won share buyback/cancellation plan (Aug 19), confirmed Temasek sovereign wealth investment, Japan Miyagi fab expansion, Dalian NAND restart, and a fresh Needham PT raise to $220 on Aug 26.
ideas.catalyst: NVDA Q2 blowout and Q3 $108B guide (Aug 26) directly validates HBM demand; Needham PT raised to $220 on Aug 26; 40T won buyback announced Aug 19 provides ongoing per-share floor
ideas.edge: Needham PT of $220 vs last close ~$159.53 = ~38% upside gap; stock ~11% off Aug 17 high of $178, consolidating mid-$150s; TipRanks flags 60% upside; buyback and Temasek investment provide structural downside support below current levels
ideas.bull_case: NVDA's sustained AI capex cycle drives accelerating HBM order flow directly to SK Hynix; the buyback reduces share count while Temasek adds institutional credibility — a combination that historically compresses discount-to-target gaps quickly in high-conviction sectors.
ideas.bear_case: SKHY trades on Korean exchanges (OTC in the US via ADR); liquidity, currency risk (KRW/USD), and geopolitical semiconductor supply-chain risk (Dalian China fab) are live concerns; any softening of AI capex guidance from other hyperscalers would reverse the read-through thesis.
